components.explanation: Six thin scenes; game.tscn is one Node with world.gd.
world.gd builds terrain, water, village, scenery, resources, player and UI at runtime.
model_library.gd rebuilds FBX materials, strips LOD/UCX meshes, stands Z-up packs upright, merges the rabbit clips.
player.gd: relative look, WASD, sprint, jump, the centre ray, swing and interact.
crafting_ui.gd and item_db.gd: categories, requirement lines, the hidden Craft button, three blueprints.
_refresh_objectives in world.gd and the HUD list in hud.gd; the (0/3) defect.
choppable_tree.gd (4 hits, fall away) and fruit_tree.gd (apples).
rabbit.gd: Unity AI_Movement wander plus flee within 5 m; Dead clip on a hit.
_place_campfire in world.gd and campfire.gd (particles, light, warmth radius).
inventory_ui.gd and inventory_slot.gd: 21 slots, drag/drop swap, hover info, right-click use.
_update_time in world.gd and the sky shader that blends three panoramas.
player_state.gd: calories, water, starvation, cold, regeneration, causes of death.
save_game/_apply_save in world.gd and the JSON slot in game_state.gd.
Main menu, intro story, How to Play, pause menu and end screens.
audio.gd: named sounds, music and night crickets; all synthesized.
_tools: the icon baker, screenshot drivers and the two playtests (32 + 10 checks) that call game functions directly.
project.godot (3 autoloads), export presets and README.
Models, textures, sky, UI, icons, fonts and audio files with their import settings.

code_result_pairs.observation: The game scene fades in fully built: terrain, village, mountains, HUD.
Orchard trees, fences and houses render upright with textures.
Synthetic relative mouse motion turns the view across the village and back.
The stick prompt appears under the crosshair; E collects it with a pickup popup.
The Axe row shows both requirements owned; Craft appears; one click consumes the materials.
Zoomed engine frames: the ticked stick and gold objectives read (0/3) right after crafting the axe.
Four axe swings shake the pine, which then topples away from the player.
A rabbit flees at close range; a sprinting axe hit plays its Dead clip.
Facing the lake, placing the campfire is refused with "You can't build a fire in the water".
An item is dragged to the last slot with a translucent preview; a right-click eats.
The sky goes to night; at 20:00 the "Night falls" warning appears.
Away from the fire at night: "You are freezing!" and the blue cold overlay.
Load Game restores 13:09 with the placed fire, stats and inventory.
